title: Chinese AI startup Zhipu says it is limiting GLM Coding Plan access after strong demand, taking only 20% of its current daily new subscriptions from January 23 (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Chinese AI startup Zhipu says it is limiting GLM Coding Plan access after strong demand, taking only 20% of its current daily new subscriptions from January 23 — China's Zhipu is limiting access to its coding assistant after strong demand for a new AI model siphoned off computing resources.
